comment: The module has no parameters at all, so every line here is a jack. Two faults in the code worth knowing: the phase store is std::array<double,8> at src/XLimitJIVCO.cpp:131 while the process loop runs to inputs[VOCT_INPUT].getChannels(), which Rack allows up to 16, so a nine-channel or wider input writes past the end of it; and the sync test at :148 is `syncVal && !syncState`, where syncState is only set true at 0.5V or more, so a steady voltage between zero and 0.5V restarts the waveform on every sample rather than once. The README says only that the module is a wavetable VCO to reduce floating point inaccuracies; it documents none of the jacks.
